answer_1.quote: The prediction of missing/masked spans of text at any position within a document (often indicated via a special placeholder symbol) is known as infilling or fill-in-the-middle.
answer_1.outputs: The model generates infilling hypotheses for masked spans in de-identified documents, such as predicting original names, dates, or other personal identifiers based on context and retrieved knowledge.

answer_2.quote: We use two metrics to judge the accuracy and performance of our re-identifications. The first is an exact match, where a re-identification is only correct if it outputs the original tokens. The second is token recall where we look at the proportion of tokens in the prediction that are also in the original span.
